Map showing where custom packaging services in Manitoba are located.  
  
  This map shows where custom packaging services in Manitoba are located. A contract packager (subcontractor) is a company that manufactures and packages food products sold by other businesses. This list is not exhaustive and does not constitute a recommendation for services. For more information, visit the Manitoba Agriculture website. <o:p></o:p>This map uses the Manitoba contract packaging point layer and is part of the Manitoba contract packaging app.  
  
  **This third party metadata element was translated using an automated translation tool (Amazon Translate).**
